notes.title: Title Screen Update #4 | Store, Logo & In-Game Purchases
notes.content:
Title Screen Update #4 *WIP*

I wanted to make it so the player can have an interactive and AWH stylized store/checkout system for purchasing episodes in game. Of course you will still be able to purchase episodes directly from steam but this will offer a more immersive experience.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=djhHe1l_3n4

Updates:
- Logo added
- FX added to logo
- Store menu Added
- Episode presentation added
- Episode purchase confirmation added
- Purchase prices set
- In game purchases *WIP*
- Launch Config Box Image Added

notes.title: Character Movement, Camera & Joypad Control In-Game Test
notes.content:
For those who haven't been following the games facebook page, here's a video showing an in game test of the character movement, camera & joypad control. 

Also I will be announcing the winner of the giveaway today for voting "Highly Anticipated" for the steam awards! Look forward to that! ^_^

Updates:
- Bar layout updated
- Volumetric lighting fog
- Dancers, dancing animations, sitting people, etc..
- Environmental fog
- Dance floor lights animations
- Reverb Area inside bar
- New music track added
- New ambiance people talking added
- Pulsing lights (custom pulsing script for emission)
- Night Club sign added
- Added more characters (sittings and dancing)
- Added DJ and holographic music interface
- Added wall light tubes
- Increased environment fog density
- Fixed audio reverb for spacial movement

https://youtu.be/nu2x-Iayp5A
